task: Task 1, lock immutable baseline and enrichment vocabulary

mutableGroups.immutableRule: Every project-controlled path outside exact groups A, B, and C is immutable for this plan. Enumeration patterns grant no ownership.

applicable.malformed_input: In-memory malformed REQ-999 and commitment strings must be rejected after edits.
applicable.stale_state: Complete pre-edit hashes make later drift detectable without Git.
applicable.dirty_worktree: Git is not used as baseline because the Wiki is untracked.
applicable.misleading_success_output: QA stores binary PASS/FAIL fields, not prose-only success claims.
applicable.generated_manifest_stale_state: Project manifest SHA-256 values are captured before content edits.

notApplicable.prompt_injection: No external untrusted content is executed or promoted; only local canonical plan and wiki files are scanned.
notApplicable.cancel_resume: Single-turn documentation task with no continuation edits owned here.
notApplicable.hung: Scanner is synchronous and finite over local files.
notApplicable.flaky: Hash and regex checks are deterministic.
notApplicable.repeated_interruption: No long-running subprocess or resumable workflow is used.

qaAfterContentEdits.channel: node -e manifest/status scanner, no temp files, no stdin
qaAfterContentEdits.manualQaSurface: Documentation deliverable read through parsed manifest/status output. Scanner validates the exact user-facing wiki contract and the failure fixtures.

cleanup.scannerMode: node -e one-off, no temp files, no stdin
